draft.shortGloss: to take; to drink; to catch

notes: In Mexico, 'tomar' is the most common verb for drinking any beverage or taking medicine; used without an object, it often means to drink alcohol.
For physically picking something up in everyday Mexican speech, 'agarrar' is just as common as 'tomar'.
